### Common Options & Ingredients

- **Pre-drink & recovery shots/pills:** Products like ZBiotics, Myrkl, Cheers Restore, and UNDO Gummies use probiotics, L-cysteine, dihydromyricetin (DHM), milk thistle, or B vitamins to target alcohol metabolism and liver support.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX-v-DE4_R1UT8SNUzevUEkGBhUL9Ptx0i8578EIhsgnPw5bgZLchYao61QW1uObEAvDluWeXKx-IlMwXkDDKF-zb6qPRvXXhF2IT2cu-OpJEuranVvHyFbf6YovW4iW0GiUcoaKCGpnDi4qJo-CZxckdgfRtwtA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1_i99U3FNJsNDBVcWC0vT3FjxNYkNjztpAGJ_cTiS2JUUmDm0GRrFi8I5sqqFfNhkSwPkwY0bCbSZ46aiLfLrTOPGCwka_U_WrpZw2G2Ku3-o6s0Mk6ayB_Nt26iYUWVoRpFvuOOP527XYy0F3ED4jxuPgiWdJWM0VyHDAW4VDdqJbQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXQM7QuI083lemQoKV3pOR-OvPQb9dME6IGR3PDus2xr94t2BTCYGkXkVGO-lEZLN70rbeKoLYw78ZImcW8BJd_Intk256pgW-siWnYoAjmWykKLIM_WMC7Bx0w9VKAdDFaBE)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXii-XKff0LhnPlfpJcWVZqdYsTxQllWmWPfWCxI60Iv3DzLK6UiusMiedN3zpfC-ZabYBsnDzPok3jjEcajSbKBpijeJJnaxzHv5027VNL6VJLSepAM45oVoK00mOw-ga-U-_d63p-aMZR9wVtMZm7eGSl1h_l_iU)
- **Hydration & electrolyte blends:** Powders and drinks like Waterboy, DripDrop, and Morning Recovery focus on replenishing fluids and minerals lost from alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXQM7QuI083lemQoKV3pOR-OvPQb9dME6IGR3PDus2xr94t2BTCYGkXkVGO-lEZLN70rbeKoLYw78ZImcW8BJd_Intk256pgW-siWnYoAjmWykKLIM_WMC7Bx0w9VKAdDFaBE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1_i99U3FNJsNDBVcWC0vT3FjxNYkNjztpAGJ_cTiS2JUUmDm0GRrFi8I5sqqFfNhkSwPkwY0bCbSZ46aiLfLrTOPGCwka_U_WrpZw2G2Ku3-o6s0Mk6ayB_Nt26iYUWVoRpFvuOOP527XYy0F3ED4jxuPgiWdJWM0VyHDAW4VDdqJbQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXh6Pv63fqr4_C2Axs8q61-xh1tESuRMf-0AKZA0BzrF5hyMiXuo5TMnV41813ufjJ6ABE1ZtdXP5sftOl9MJSIos3f14NAkoVP83N18tKub8QrclgOCGvczSwPf3lG6bxa1mNEOYB8vk)
- **Where to shop:** You can browse options at [Target](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXQM7QuI083lemQoKV3pOR-OvPQb9dME6IGR3PDus2xr94t2BTCYGkXkVGO-lEZLN70rbeKoLYw78ZImcW8BJd_Intk256pgW-siWnYoAjmWykKLIM_WMC7Bx0w9VKAdDFaBE), [Walgreens](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXX4JRglVybgk3QLT_Vi1ML_MPIRE67qWXMwvFtBrtPO3Pyu4uhqoO7L_BBC0WD7ELW5NLiFkbZWmd-gSvUYT4296jxV7sDNKYFjCYgddiVYnqdO50PRJMrgfUiSRiWTas_G1jVp8qCIOOPWYEBjpkBPA) , or [Amazon](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXii-XKff0LhnPlfpJcWVZqdYsTxQllWmWPfWCxI60Iv3DzLK6UiusMiedN3zpfC-ZabYBsnDzPok3jjEcajSbKBpijeJJnaxzHv5027VNL6VJLSepAM45oVoK00mOw-ga-U-_d63p-aMZR9wVtMZm7eGSl1h_l_iU).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXXQM7QuI083lemQoKV3pOR-OvPQb9dME6IGR3PDus2xr94t2BTCYGkXkVGO-lEZLN70rbeKoLYw78ZImcW8BJd_Intk256pgW-siWnYoAjmWykKLIM_WMC7Bx0w9VKAdDFaBE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXX4JRglVybgk3QLT_Vi1ML_MPIRE67qWXMwvFtBrtPO3Pyu4uhqoO7L_BBC0WD7ELW5NLiFkbZWmd-gSvUYT4296jxV7sDNKYFjCYgddiVYnqdO50PRJMrgfUiSRiWTas_G1jVp8qCIOOPWYEBjpkBPA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXii-XKff0LhnPlfpJcWVZqdYsTxQllWmWPfWCxI60Iv3DzLK6UiusMiedN3zpfC-ZabYBsnDzPok3jjEcajSbKBpijeJJnaxzHv5027VNL6VJLSepAM45oVoK00mOw-ga-U-_d63p-aMZR9wVtMZm7eGSl1h_l_iU)

### What to Keep in Mind

- **Limited evidence:** Reviews and medical experts note a lack of large, double-blind clinical trials proving these supplements reliably cure or prevent hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF195rsqGbDbWUx_qfkuGhFYZVyEUiugPwb9Tf4szgW4rHFJxshT18wQVzBB0BQkQ3Swl06Fn_7s-jWNBqT1oswrDFl4aicd_Yk6m9MbkZfx0Gv0P6G5QRzyB3K3OVSXi3a2zlU1tV0vaBxGNwCoaa4aCIPrVRqMPJsC37EFWbqw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1_i99U3FNJsNDBVcWC0vT3FjxNYkNjztpAGJ_cTiS2JUUmDm0GRrFi8I5sqqFfNhkSwPkwY0bCbSZ46aiLfLrTOPGCwka_U_WrpZw2G2Ku3-o6s0Mk6ayB_Nt26iYUWVoRpFvuOOP527XYy0F3ED4jxuPgiWdJWM0VyHDAW4VDdqJbQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX-v-DE4_R1UT8SNUzevUEkGBhUL9Ptx0i8578EIhsgnPw5bgZLchYao61QW1uObEAvDluWeXKx-IlMwXkDDKF-zb6qPRvXXhF2IT2cu-OpJEuranVvHyFbf6YovW4iW0GiUcoaKCGpnDi4qJo-CZxckdgfRtwtA)
- **No substitute for basics:** Drinking water, eating food before or while drinking, and pacing or limiting alcohol remain the most reliable ways to reduce hangover risk.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXUIMmAqBuGcWNJttje_AkYKPPxrTf740zcLfpF7FYnch-1D6XfNteDpNCk5dZTf6o0a-zOMXyh4P5vuvn2dDTFGX0GZPw_2_aQn1ACawUi8u2qTxntw2V9u1MuZVnzfSgFFAb9GP2vGs2r7Zx2PWf)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1_i99U3FNJsNDBVcWC0vT3FjxNYkNjztpAGJ_cTiS2JUUmDm0GRrFi8I5sqqFfNhkSwPkwY0bCbSZ46aiLfLrTOPGCwka_U_WrpZw2G2Ku3-o6s0Mk6ayB_Nt26iYUWVoRpFvuOOP527XYy0F3ED4jxuPgiWdJWM0VyHDAW4VDdqJbQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF195rsqGbDbWUx_qfkuGhFYZVyEUiugPwb9Tf4szgW4rHFJxshT18wQVzBB0BQkQ3Swl06Fn_7s-jWNBqT1oswrDFl4aicd_Yk6m9MbkZfx0Gv0P6G5QRzyB3K3OVSXi3a2zlU1tV0vaBxGNwCoaa4aCIPrVRqMPJsC37EFWbqw)
- **Medication interactions:** Check with a doctor or pharmacist before combining supplements or pain relievers (like NSAIDs) with alcohol, especially if you have liver, stomach, or kidney concerns.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXUIMmAqBuGcWNJttje_AkYKPPxrTf740zcLfpF7FYnch-1D6XfNteDpNCk5dZTf6o0a-zOMXyh4P5vuvn2dDTFGX0GZPw_2_aQn1ACawUi8u2qTxntw2V9u1MuZVnzfSgFFAb9GP2vGs2r7Zx2PWf)

For more details on the science behind these formulas, see [TIME](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1_i99U3FNJsNDBVcWC0vT3FjxNYkNjztpAGJ_cTiS2JUUmDm0GRrFi8I5sqqFfNhkSwPkwY0bCbSZ46aiLfLrTOPGCwka_U_WrpZw2G2Ku3-o6s0Mk6ayB_Nt26iYUWVoRpFvuOOP527XYy0F3ED4jxuPgiWdJWM0VyHDAW4VDdqJbQ) and [WIRED](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX-v-DE4_R1UT8SNUzevUEkGBhUL9Ptx0i8578EIhsgnPw5bgZLchYao61QW1uObEAvDluWeXKx-IlMwXkDDKF-zb6qPRvXXhF2IT2cu-OpJEuranVvHyFbf6YovW4iW0GiUcoaKCGpnDi4qJo-CZxckdgfRtwtA).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1_i99U3FNJsNDBVcWC0vT3FjxNYkNjztpAGJ_cTiS2JUUmDm0GRrFi8I5sqqFfNhkSwPkwY0bCbSZ46aiLfLrTOPGCwka_U_WrpZw2G2Ku3-o6s0Mk6ayB_Nt26iYUWVoRpFvuOOP527XYy0F3ED4jxuPgiWdJWM0VyHDAW4VDdqJbQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXX-v-DE4_R1UT8SNUzevUEkGBhUL9Ptx0i8578EIhsgnPw5bgZLchYao61QW1uObEAvDluWeXKx-IlMwXkDDKF-zb6qPRvXXhF2IT2cu-OpJEuranVvHyFbf6YovW4iW0GiUcoaKCGpnDi4qJo-CZxckdgfRtwtA)To help narrow down options, let me know:

- **How you plan to take it** (before drinking, with electrolytes overnight, or the next morning)
- **Preferred format** (drink mixes, shots, gummies, or capsules)
- **Budget** or any **ingredient preferences** (such as sugar-free or vegan)

- **Medication interactions:** Check with a doctor or pharmacist before combining supplements or pain relievers (like NSAIDs) with alcohol, especially if you have liver, stomach, or kidney concerns.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXUIMmAqBuGcWNJttje_AkYKPPxrTf740zcLfpF7FYnch-1D6XfNteDpNCk5dZTf6o0a-zOMXyh4P5vuvn2dDTFGX0GZPw_2_aQn1ACawUi8u2qTxntw2V9u1MuZVnzfSgFFAb9GP2vGs2r7Zx2PWf)
